name: plate_rack
title: Plate rack
about: A two-finger gripper picks a dinner plate up by its rim and slides it upright into a wire drying rack.
short: A gripper lifts a plate by its rim and sets it in a wire rack.

name: cup_unpacking
title: Cup unpacking
about: A gripper reaches into a box of 276 loose packing pieces, finds the mug buried inside and lifts it out.
short: A gripper digs a mug out of a box of 276 packing pieces.

name: viaduct_kit
title: Viaduct kit
about: A robot arm lifts the upper tier of a toy viaduct and seats it onto the keyed pegs of the lower tier.
short: A robot arm seats the top tier of a toy viaduct onto its pegs.

name: drawer_fork
title: Drawer and fork
about: The arm pulls an unpowered drawer open by its handle, then picks up a fork and places it in the drawer's tray.
short: Pull open a drawer, then put a fork in its tray.

name: toy_piano
title: Toy piano
about: A UR5e arm with a 20-joint Wuji hand plays Ode to Joy on a toy piano, then moves up an octave for a C major chord. Each key is a hinged body on a return spring between two stops, pressed by the fingers.
short: A robot hand plays Ode to Joy on a toy piano.

name: jenga
title: Jenga
about: The arm picks up a loose block and places it across the top of the tower, continuing the alternating pattern.
short: Lift a loose block and add it to the top of the tower.

name: balance_board
title: Balance board
about: A spring-loaded balance beam tips because one counterweight is missing; the arm puts it back and the beam levels out.
short: Restore balance by placing the missing counterweight.

name: toaster
title: Toaster
about: The arm turns a bread slice upright, drops it into the second slot and presses the lever; the spring-loaded carriage latches down.
short: Insert a slice of bread and press the toaster lever.

name: cereal
title: Cereal
about: The arm lifts an open carton of 168 letter-shaped cereal pieces, pours them into a bowl and sets the carton back down.
short: Pour 168 alphabet letters from a carton into a bowl.

name: box_turn
title: Box turn
about: Two arms hold a box between their fingertips only, flip it onto its side and then turn it a quarter turn.
short: Two arms pinch a box between their fingertips, flip it and turn it.

name: beer_pong
title: Beer pong
about: The arm picks up a ping-pong ball and throws it; it bounces once on the table and lands in the front cup.
short: Throw a ping-pong ball: one bounce, then into the cup.

name: wrecking_ball
title: Wrecking ball
about: A robot turns the crank of a toy crane; its chain-and-ball swings into a three-storey block building and knocks it down.
short: A robot winds a crane whose swinging chain knocks down a building.

name: toy_well
title: Toy well
about: A robot turns the crank of a toy well; the drum winds up a flexible rope and lifts the bucket out.
short: A robot turns a crank that winds a rope and lifts a bucket.

name: pelican_bicycle
title: Pelican bicycle
about: A robot slides a lever that controls how fast a wind-up pelican pedals its bicycle.
short: A robot slides a lever that sets a pedalling pelican's speed.

name: toy_train
title: Toy train
about: The arm pushes a jointed toy train along a lane; its wheels spin freely as it rolls.
short: Push a toy train along a track on its free-spinning wheels.

name: spinning_top
title: Spinning top
about: A motorised chuck grips the top's stem, spins it up and releases it; the top keeps spinning upright on its tip.
short: A spinning chuck winds up a top and lets it go on its tip.

name: air_hockey
title: Air hockey
about: A robot arm with a mallet strikes a free puck across the table and into the far goal.
short: A robot arm strikes a puck into the far goal.

name: trebuchet
title: Trebuchet
about: A falling counterweight swings the throwing arm; the boulder leaves the cup and smashes into a dry-stacked brick wall.
short: A counterweight trebuchet hurls a boulder at a brick wall.

name: bolt_sweep
title: Bolt sweep
about: A robot drags a scraper across the table and sweeps 96 loose nuts, bolts and washers into a bin.
short: A scraper sweeps 96 nuts, bolts and washers into a bin.

name: brick_pour
title: Brick pour
about: The arm tips a jar of studded toy bricks; they tumble out and slide down three collection chutes.
short: Pour toy bricks from a jar down three chutes.

name: lava_fall
title: Lava fall
about: A small humanoid figure tips off its stand and sinks into a pot filled with 200 loose flame-shaped pieces.
short: A toy robot falls backwards into a pot of 200 flame pieces.

name: dominoes
title: Dominoes
about: A spiral of 480 dominoes falls one after another, winding in to the center of an endless floor.
short: 480 dominoes topple one after another along a spiral.

name: sleeping
title: Sleeping
about: Short stacks of boxes settle and go to sleep, costing nothing; drag any box to wake it and its neighbours.
short: 36 boxes come to rest and stop being simulated; drag one to wake it.

name: overlap
title: Overlapping boxes
about: Twenty boxes start 15 mm inside one another. With the velocity cleanup pass they separate gently instead of flying apart.
short: 20 boxes start deep inside each other and separate gently.

name: card_house
title: Card house
about: A four-level house of cards: leaning pairs and flat cards on top, standing on friction alone.
short: Four levels of playing cards held up by friction alone.

name: ratio_stack
title: Mass-ratio stack
about: Six cubes, each about three times heavier than the one beneath it. Momentum keeps the tower standing; switch it off and it topples within seconds.
short: Six cubes, each three times heavier than the one below.

name: d6
title: Six-axis joints
about: Configurable joints: a motor-driven gantry carrying a pendulum, a universal joint that stops at its limit, and a free gimbal.
short: A driven gantry, a universal joint and a gimbal.

name: linkages
title: Linkages
about: Two pendulums copy the gold one's angle (reversed and halved), and a crank drives a closed four-bar linkage.
short: Copied joint motion and a closed four-bar linkage.

name: drives
title: Joint motors
about: Three arms are driven to the same target angle with torque limits of 3, 10 and 60 N·m and a speed limit of 2 rad/s.
short: Three arms driven to the same angle with different torque limits.

name: vel_limit
title: Joint speed limits
about: Two double pendulums swing from the same start. The grey one is free; the gold one's joints are limited to 1.5 rad/s.
short: Two double pendulums; the gold one has a speed limit.

name: load_friction
title: Load-dependent friction
about: Two loaded pendulums are released at 45°. The gold hinge's friction grows with the load it carries, so it holds still.
short: A hinge whose friction grows with load holds a heavy pendulum.

name: ragdoll
title: Ragdoll
about: A ten-part ragdoll with a free-floating torso is thrown onto a staircase and tumbles down.
short: A 10-part ragdoll tumbles down a staircase.

name: incline
title: Incline
about: A box and stacks of two and three rest on a 22° slope. Friction anchors keep them from slowly creeping downhill.
short: A box and two stacks rest on a 22° slope without sliding.

name: rods
title: Sliding blocks
about: Tall blocks are launched across a high-friction floor at 1 to 3 m/s; they slide, catch and tip over.
short: Tall blocks slide across a grippy floor and tip over.

name: spin_roll
title: Spinning and rolling friction
about: Balls are set spinning and rolling. With spinning and rolling friction the gold ones come to rest; the grey ones keep going.
short: The gold balls stop spinning and rolling; the grey ones keep going.

name: torsion
title: Pinch grip
about: Two pairs of round fingertips pinch a bar away from its centre. The gold pair resists twisting and holds it level; the grey bar swings down.
short: Fingertips pinch a bar off-centre; the gold pair holds it level.

name: dumbbells
title: Dumbbells
about: A rolling dumbbell and a spinning one gradually come to rest under rolling and spinning friction.
short: Rolling and spinning dumbbells come to rest.

name: bounce
title: Bounce
about: Balls drop onto pads with bounciness from 0 (dead) to 0.9, left to right.
short: Balls bounce on pads from dead to very bouncy.

name: compliance
title: Soft contacts
about: Three 1 kg blocks land on contacts of different stiffness and settle about 10, 1 and 0.1 mm into the ground.
short: Blocks sink into soft, medium and firm contacts.

name: body_limits
title: Speed caps
about: Gold versus grey: a 1 m/s fall-speed cap, a 5 rad/s spin cap, and spin damping on otherwise frictionless spinners.
short: Gold bodies have a fall-speed cap, a spin cap and spin damping.

name: kinematic
title: Kinematic paddle
about: A paddle moving on a prescribed path sweeps boxes aside; the gold box above floats because its gravity is switched off.
short: A paddle on a fixed path sweeps boxes; one box ignores gravity.
